text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp. I arrived at the 
seaside camp with Nice Nature and her 
friends, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Nature! Nature, Nature, Natureeee!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Let's play, let's play! Turbo's bored~! 
Why are you looking at the neighborhood 
newsletter~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's not a neighborhood newsletter 
circular. I'm planning out race schedules.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um... if I win this, and win that, and 
then win a GIII after that...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I might just be able to run in it. 
The Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho...? Nature, you're running 
in the Kikuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Teio hasn't given up yet. And as 
long as she hasn't, she'll have a chance 
to pay back that loss."

Nice Nature was fired up for autumn. In 
that case—
choice_data_list: Should we make a plan too, Twin Turbo?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Um~, I'm not really sure 
about the race order and all that, 
though~.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
First I'll win, then I'll win next, then 
I'll win something, and win some more...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'm gonna win 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You can hardly call that a plan, right?!

"...Jokes aside, there was something even 
more important to Twin Turbo than a race 
plan. And that was—"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Deyaaaaaaaaaaah!!!! Take that, and that, 
daaaaaahhhh!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, wheeeeeze*... I can't... 
breathe~~~!
choice_data_list: Could we take a breather somewhere?
Can't we catch our breath somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"I can't do something like that~! 'Cause 
it's just not very Turbo!"

The first thing Twin Turbo needed to work 
on was fixing her habit of running without 
pacing her breathing, an issue that had 
persisted for quite some time.

An all-or-nothing charge is Twin Turbo's 
trademark. Still, this was a bit too much 
of a wipeout...

I've managed to get by on sheer willpower 
until now, but it was obvious this would 
lead to trouble down the road.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“‘Running without catching a breath,’ huh? 
Then why not have her try free diving?”

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heeere I gooooo, Turbo's challenging her 
limits!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Gurgle gurgle gurgle, I'm gonna drown~, 
Trainer!

...It was no good. No matter what I have 
her do, she gleefully charges in until she 
hits her limit...

"There was no choice but to somehow have 
them master proper pacing and catching 
their breath over this summer."
